selected.description: Malaysian singer-songwriter known for her soulful voice and blend of pop, R&B, and folk music.

properties.description: Zee Avi is a Malaysian singer-songwriter and musician who gained international recognition for her unique blend of indie pop, folk, and acoustic music. She is known for her soothing vocals, intricate guitar work, and heartfelt songwriting. Zee Avi's music often incorporates elements of jazz and blues, creating a mellow and intimate sound. She first gained attention through YouTube and has since released several albums, earning a dedicated fanbase worldwide.
Alextbh is a music artist known primarily for hip hop and rap genres. Specific details about his biography, vocal range, and collaborations are not widely documented.

Birdy, born Jasmine Lucilla Elizabeth Jennifer van den Bogaerde, is an English singer, songwriter, and musician who gained fame as a teenager with her cover of Bon Iver's 'Skinny Love.' She is known for her emotive, delicate voice and her blend of indie pop and folk music. Birdy's music often features piano-driven melodies and introspective lyrics, and she has released several albums showcasing her growth as an artist.

Daniela Andrade is a Canadian singer-songwriter and musician recognized for her gentle, acoustic-driven indie pop and folk music. She gained popularity through her YouTube channel where she posts covers and original songs, characterized by her intimate vocal style and minimalist arrangements. Her music often features themes of love, introspection, and personal growth, delivered with a soothing and emotive voice.

BANKS (Jillian Rose Banks) is an American singer-songwriter who blends moody electropop with alternative R&B and downtempo electronic production. She emerged internationally after two 2013 EPs (Fall Over, London) and received critical acclaim for her debut album Goddess (2014), which spawned the platinum single "Beggin for Thread." Subsequent albums The Altar (2016) and III (2019) reinforced her reputation for intimate, atmospheric production, confessional lyrics, and a dark, minimalist aesthetic.

The Sam Willows is a Singaporean indie pop band formed in 2011, consisting of siblings Narelle and Benjamin Kheng, Sandra Riley Tang, and Jonathan Chua. They are known for their melodic indie pop and pop rock sound, blending harmonious vocals with catchy melodies and thoughtful lyrics. The band has gained popularity in Southeast Asia and has released several albums and EPs, contributing significantly to the indie music scene in Singapore.

Kimbra Lee Johnson, known mononymously as Kimbra, is a New Zealand singer and songwriter who gained international recognition for her unique blend of indie pop, alternative R&B, and art pop. She is noted for her eclectic musical style that incorporates elements of jazz, funk, and electronic music, as well as her distinctive vocal techniques and layered harmonies. Kimbra first rose to prominence with her collaboration on Gotye's hit single "Somebody That I Used to Know," which won multiple awards and brought her global attention. Her solo work is characterized by experimental production, complex rhythms, and introspective lyrics.

Sam Smith is an English singer and songwriter who rose to fame in 2012 featuring on Disclosure's breakthrough single "Latch". Known for their soulful voice and emotional ballads, Smith has won multiple awards including Grammys and an Academy Award. Their music blends pop, soul, and R&B with themes of love, heartbreak, and self-acceptance.

Ellie Goulding is an English singer-songwriter who rose to prominence in the early 2010s with a signature breathy soprano, blending folky songwriting with synth-driven electronic pop. Her debut album 'Lights' (2010) and follow-ups 'Halcyon' (2012) and 'Delirium' (2015) produced international hits including 'Lights', 'Starry Eyed', 'Burn' and 'Love Me Like You Do' (a global smash from the Fifty Shades of Grey soundtrack). She has collaborated with prominent producers and artists across pop and EDM, won critical awards early in her career, and built a global fanbase through chart success, festival appearances and high-profile collaborations. She is also known for charitable and environmental advocacy and was appointed MBE in 2023.

Jayesslee is a musical duo composed of sisters Janice and Sonia Lee, known for their harmonious pop and acoustic folk music. They gained popularity through their YouTube channel where they posted cover songs and original music, attracting a global audience. Their style blends soft pop melodies with acoustic instrumentation, often featuring heartfelt lyrics and vocal harmonies.

Adele Laurie Blue Adkins MBE (born 1988) is an English singer-songwriter whose rich, powerful voice and piano-driven ballads have made her one of the best-selling artists of the 21st century. After graduating from the BRIT School she signed to XL Recordings and released 19 (2008), 21 (2011), 25 (2015) and 30 (2021). Adele's albums have broken sales records worldwide; she has won multiple Grammys, Brit Awards and an Academy Award for "Skyfall." She is noted for emotive songwriting, vintage-tinged production, and a focus on vocal performance.

Kina Grannis is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist who gained popularity through her heartfelt acoustic pop and folk music. She is known for her intimate vocal style and lyrical storytelling, often accompanied by her guitar. Kina first rose to prominence via YouTube, where her music videos and covers attracted a large following. Her music blends elements of acoustic, pop, and folk genres, characterized by gentle melodies and personal lyrics.

Giselle (Hangul: 지젤) is a Japanese–Korean singer signed to SM Entertainment who debuted on November 17, 2020 as the main rapper and a vocalist of the K-pop girl group aespa. She is known for bilingual delivery, blending rap and melodic vocals within the group's futuristic, electronic-influenced pop concept.

Jeff Bernat is a Filipino-American singer-songwriter and producer who gained recognition for his smooth, soulful voice and laid-back R&B style. He blends elements of soul, pop, and jazz to create a mellow and intimate sound. Bernat's music often features acoustic instrumentation and heartfelt lyrics, appealing to fans of contemporary R&B and neo soul. He has built a dedicated fanbase through his independent releases and has been praised for his vocal delivery and songwriting skills.

Ta-ku is an Australian music producer, singer, songwriter, and artist known for his soulful blend of hip hop, R&B, and electronic music. He has gained recognition for his emotive beatmaking and instrumental tracks, often incorporating elements of soul and electronic music. Ta-ku has released several albums and EPs, and is also known for his collaborations with other artists and his work in the creative arts beyond music.
